note: Set A binds every table value to the correct column, row and unit (N·m² for the stiffness columns, kg·m for the inertia columns), and its mass-center and total-mass claims match the prose. Set B repeatedly gives the stiffness units as N·m³ instead of N·m², misreads the label TwFAIner as "TwFAlner", repeats the TwFAStif 614.34E+9 fact twice, and identifies rows only as "row 1/row 2". Set A's only weakness is a quote truncated at the page break for the 38.234 m mass center, whose condition is inferred from the Elevation definition.
remarks: The sentence giving the tower mass center is cut off at the page break ('...38.234 m along the'); the continuation is not on this page, so the condition 'along the tower centerline relative to the tower base' is a plausible completion rather than a directly quoted one. B's unit error is systematic (all TwFAStif/TwSSStif/TwGJStif claims use N·m³), suggesting a column-unit mapping bug rather than isolated OCR noise. Both sets report the TwFAcgOf/TwSScgOf = 0.0 entries, which are trivially zero for every row; neither set captures the 30% thickness increase or the density-correction factor of 7,850 kg/m³ mentioned in the prose (possibly among the unshown shared claims).
